_schema_notes.primary_source: Optidrive ODE-3 (E3) IP20 User Guide, Revision 1.05, document code 82-E3I20-IN, for firmware 3.11. Section 6 Parameters, pages 18-26. All values verified against rendered page images.
_schema_notes.verbatim_policy: All names, ranges, defaults and units are exactly as printed, including values expressed as other parameter IDs (e.g. max = 'P-01'), dual printed values (e.g. '50.0 (60.0)', '250 / 500'), and 'Drive Dependent' / 'Drive Rating Dependent' / 'See Below' / 'N/A' / '-' spans. Nothing was normalised.
_schema_notes.settings_field: 'settings' is an extension field listing enumerated option values verbatim from the source where the parameter has a settings list. 'indices' is an extension field for parameters the source documents as multiple Index rows, each with its own range/default/units.
_schema_notes.read_only_group: P00-xx Read Only Status Parameters (source section 6.4, page 26) are provided in the separate 'read_only_status_parameters' array; the source gives them no min/max/default, only Description and Explanation.
_schema_notes.parameter_numbering: The source lists P-01 to P-63 and P-66. There are no rows for P-64 or P-65. Standard = P-01 to P-14 (section 6.1), Extended = P-15 to P-50 (section 6.2), Advanced = P-51 to P-66 (section 6.3).

parameters.name: Maximum Frequency / Speed Limit
parameters.function: Maximum output frequency or motor speed limit - Hz or RPM. If P-10 >0, the value entered / displayed is in RPM.
parameters.notes: The Default column prints '50.0 (60.0)'. The source table does not state what the parenthesised value applies to. The Quick Start Overview (page 6) says: 'Adjust the potentiometer to vary the speed from P-02 (0Hz default) to P-01 (50 / 60 Hz default)'.

parameters.name: Stopping Mode / Mains Loss Response
parameters.function: Selects the stopping mode of the drive, and the behaviour in response to a loss of mains power supply during operation.
settings: 0: On Disable = Ramp to Stop (P-04); On Mains Loss = Ride Through (Recover energy from load to maintain operation)
1: On Disable = Coast; On Mains Loss = Coast
2: On Disable = Ramp to Stop (P-04); On Mains Loss = Fast Ramp to Stop (P-24), Coast if P-24 = 0
3: On Disable = Ramp to Stop (P-04) with AC Flux Braking; On Mains Loss = Fast Ramp to Stop (P-24), Coast if P-24 = 0
4: On Disable = Ramp to Stop (P-04); On Mains Loss = No action

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Energy Optimiser
parameters.function: Motor Energy Optimisation is intended for use in applications where the motor operates for extended time periods at constant speed with light load. It should not be used in applications with large, sudden step changes in load or for PI control applications. Optidrive Energy Optimisation reduces the drive internal heat losses increasing efficiency however it may result in some vibration in the motor during light load operation. In general, this function is suited to Fan, Pump and Compressor applications.
settings: 0: Motor Energy Optimisation = Disabled; Optidrive Energy Optimisation = Disabled
1: Motor Energy Optimisation = Enabled; Optidrive Energy Optimisation = Disabled
2: Motor Energy Optimisation = Disabled; Optidrive Energy Optimisation = Enabled
3: Motor Energy Optimisation = Enabled; Optidrive Energy Optimisation = Enabled

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Motor Rated Voltage / Back EMF at rated speed (PM / BLDC)
parameters.function: For Induction Motors, this parameter should be set to the rated (nameplate) voltage of the motor (Volts). For Permanent Magnet or Brushless DC Motors, it should be set to the Back EMF at rated speed.
parameters.notes: Maximum and Default columns each print two values ('250 / 500' and '230 / 400'). The parameter table does not state which value applies to which drive voltage rating.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Motor Rated Frequency
parameters.function: This parameter should be set to the rated (nameplate) frequency of the motor.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Motor Rated Speed
parameters.function: This parameter can optionally be set to the rated (nameplate) RPM of the motor. When set to the default value of zero, all speed related parameters are displayed in Hz and the slip compensation (where motor speed is maintained at a constant value regardless of applied load) for the motor is disabled. Entering the value from the motor nameplate enables the slip compensation function, and the Optidrive display will now show motor speed in RPM. All speed related parameters, such as Minimum and Maximum Speed, Preset Speeds etc. will also be displayed in RPM.
parameters.notes: NOTE If P-09 value is changed, P-10 value is reset to 0.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Low Frequency Torque Boost
parameters.function: Low frequency torque can be improved by increasing this parameter. Excessive boost levels may however result in high motor current and increased risk of tripping on Over Current or Motor Overload (refer to section 10.1. Fault Code Messages on page 39). This parameter operates in conjunction with P-51 (Motor Control Mode).
settings: P-51 = 0, P-11 = 0: Boost is automatically calculated according to autotune data.
P-51 = 0, P-11 > 0: Voltage boost = P-11 x P-07. This voltage is applied at 0.0Hz, and linearly reduced until P-09 / 2.
P-51 = 1, P-11 = All: Voltage boost = P-11 x P-07. This voltage is applied at 0.0Hz, and linearly reduced until P-09 / 2.
P-51 = 2, 3, 4, 5, P-11 = All: Boost current level = 4*P-11*P-08.
parameters.notes: For IM motors, when P-51 = 0 or 1, a suitable setting can usually be found by operating the motor under very low or no load conditions at approximately 5Hz, and adjusting P-11 until the motor current is approximately the magnetising current (if known) or in the range shown below. Frame Size 1: 60 - 80% of motor rated current. Frame Size 2: 50 - 60% of motor rated current. Frame Size 3: 40 - 50% of motor rated current. Frame Size 4 & 5: 35 - 45% of motor rated current.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Primary Command Source
parameters.function: Selects the main drive control source and determines how the output frequency of the drive is primarily controlled (see also section 7.1, page 27).
settings: 0: Terminal Control. The drive responds directly to signals applied to the control terminals.
1: Uni-directional Keypad Control. The drive can be controlled in the forward direction only using the internal keypad, or an external remote Keypad.

2: Bi-directional Keypad Control. The drive can be controlled in the forward and reverse directions u using the internal keypad, or an external remote Keypad. Pressing the keypad START button toggles between forward and reverse.
3: Modbus Network Control. Control via Modbus RTU (RS485) using the internal Accel / Decel ramps.
4: Modbus Network Control. Control via Modbus RTU (RS485) interface with Accel / Decel ramps updated via Modbus.
5: PI Control. User PI control with external feedback signal.
6: PI Analog Summation Control. PI control with external feedback signal and summation with analog input 1.
7: CAN Control. Control via CAN (RS485) using the internal Accel / Decel ramps.
8: CAN Control. Control via CAN (RS485) interface with Accel / Decel ramps updated via CAN.
9: Slave Mode. Control via a connected Invertek drive in Master Mode. Slave drive address must be > 1.
parameters.notes: NOTE When P-12 = 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8 or 9, an enable signal must still be provided at the control terminals, digital input 1. (Setting 2 text 'directions u using' is as printed in the source.)

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Operating Mode Select
parameters.function: Provides a quick set up to configure key parameters according to the intended application of the drive. Parameters are preset according to the table.
settings: 0: Industrial Mode. Intended for general purpose applications. Presets: Current Limit (P-54) 150%, Torque Characteristic Constant, Spin Start (P-33) 0: Off, Thermal Overload Limit Reaction (P-60 Index 2) 0: Trip

1: Pump Mode. Intended for centrifugal pump applications. Presets: Current Limit (P-54) 110%, Torque Characteristic Variable, Spin Start (P-33) 0: Off, Thermal Overload Limit Reaction (P-60 Index 2) 1: Current Limit Reduction

2: Fan Mode. Intended for Fan applications. Presets: Current Limit (P-54) 110%, Torque Characteristic Variable, Spin Start (P-33) 2: On, Thermal Overload Limit Reaction (P-60 Index 2) 1: Current Limit Reduction

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Digital Input Function Select
parameters.function: Defines the function of the digital inputs depending on the control mode setting in P-12. See section 7. Analog and Digital Input Macro Configurations on page 27 for more information.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Analog Input 1 Signal Format
parameters.function: Selects the signal format for Analog Input 1.
settings: U 0-10 = Uni-polar 0 to 10 Volt Signal. The drive will remain at minimum speed (P-02) if the analog reference after scaling and offset are applied is =<0.0%. 100% signal means the output frequency / speed will be the value set in P-01.

b 0-10 = Uni-polar 0 to 10 Volt Signal, bi-directional operation. The drive will operate the motor in the reverse direction of rotation if the analog reference after scaling and offset are applied is <0.0%. e.g. for bidirectional control from a 0 - 10 volt signal, set P-35 = 200.0%, P-39 = 50.0%.
A 0-20 = 0 to 20mA Signal.
t 4-20 = 4 to 20mA Signal, the Optidrive will trip and show the fault code 4-20F 500ms after the signal level falls below 3mA.
r 4-20 = 4 to 20mA Signal, the Optidrive will run at Preset Speed 1 (P-20 if the signal level falls below 3mA.
t 20-4 = 20 to 4mA Signal, the Optidrive will trip and show the fault code 4-20F 500ms after the signal level falls below 3mA.
r 20-4 = 20 to 4mA Signal, the Optidrive will run at Preset Speed 1 (P-20 if the signal level falls below 3mA.
U 10-0 = 10 to 0 Volt Signal (Uni-polar). The drive will operate at Maximum Frequency / Speed if the analog reference after scaling and offset are applied is =<0.0%.
parameters.notes: Setting mnemonics are 7-segment display renderings transcribed from the page image. The unclosed parenthesis in '(P-20 if the signal level falls below 3mA.' is as printed in the source for the r 4-20 and r 20-4 rows of P-16.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Maximum Effective Switching Frequency
parameters.function: Sets maximum effective switching frequency of the drive. If "rEd" is displayed when the parameter is viewed, the switching frequency has been reduced to the level in P00-32 due to excessive drive heatsink temperature.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Output Relay Function Select
parameters.function: Selects the function assigned to the relay output. The relay has two output terminals, Logic 1 indicates the relay is active, and therefore terminals 10 and 11 will be connected.
settings: 0: Drive Enabled (Running). Logic 1 when the motor is enabled.
1: Drive Healthy. Logic 1 when power is applied to the drive and no fault exists.
2: At Target Frequency (Speed). Logic 1 when the output frequency matches the setpoint frequency.
3: Drive Tripped. Logic 1 when the drive is in a fault condition.
4: Output Frequency >= Limit. Logic 1 when the output frequency exceeds the adjustable limit set in P-19.
5: Output Current >= Limit. Logic 1 when the motor current exceeds the adjustable limit set in P-19.
6: Output Frequency < Limit. Logic 1 when the output frequency is below the adjustable limit set in P-19.
7: Output Current < Limit. Logic 1 when the motor current is below the adjustable limit set in P-19.
8: Analog Input 2 > Limit. Logic 1 when the signal applied to analog input 2 exceeds the adjustable limit set in P-19.
9: Drive Ready to Run. Logic 1 when the drive is ready to run, no trip present.
10: Fire Mode Active. Logic 1 when Fire Mode is activated.
11: Output Frequency > Limit and not Fire Mode. As setting 4 however the output relay state does not change if the drive is in Fire Mode.
12: Fieldbus. Status is controlled by bit 8 of the fieldbus control word. Fieldbus type is selected by P-12.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Relay Threshold Level
parameters.function: Adjustable threshold used in conjunction with settings 4 to 7 of P-18 and P-25.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: 2nd Ramp Time (Fast Stop)
parameters.function: This parameter allows a 2nd ramp time to be programmed into the drive. This ramp time is automatically selected in the case of a mains power loss if P-05 = 2 or 3. When set to 0.00, the drive will coast to stop. When using a setting of P-15 that provides a "Fast Stop" function, this ramp time is also used.
parameters.notes: In addition, if P-24 > 0, P-02 > 0, P-26=0 and P-27 = P-02, this ramp time is applied to both acceleration and deceleration when operating below minimum speed, allowing selection of an alternative ramp when operating outside of the normal speed range, which may be useful in pump and compressor applications.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Analog Output Function Select
parameters.function: Selects the function of the analog output. Digital Output Mode: Logic 1 = +24V DC. Analog Output Mode: settings 8 onwards.
settings: 0: Drive Enabled (Running). Logic 1 when the Optidrive is enabled (Running).
1: Drive Healthy. Logic 1 When no Fault condition exists on the drive.
2: At Target Frequency (Speed). Logic 1 when the output frequency matches the setpoint frequency.
3: Drive Tripped. Logic 1 when the drive is in a fault condition.
4: Output Frequency >= Limit. Logic 1 when the output frequency exceeds the adjustable limit set in P-19.
5: Output Current >= Limit. Logic 1 when the motor current exceeds the adjustable limit set in P-19.
6: Output Frequency < Limit. Logic 1 when the output frequency is below the adjustable limit set in P-19.
7: Output Current < Limit. Logic 1 when the motor current is below the adjustable limit set in P-19.
8: Output Frequency (Motor Speed). 0 to P-01, resolution 0.1Hz.
9: Output (Motor) Current. 0 to 200% of P-08, resolution 0.1A.
10: Output Power. 0 - 200% of drive rated power.
11: Load Current. 0 - 200% of P-08, resolution 0.1A.
12: Fieldbus Digital. Status is controlled by PDO0 Bit 9.
13: Fieldbus Analog. Analog output value set by PDO2 value, 0 - 4096.
parameters.notes: SOURCE INCONSISTENCY: the printed Maximum is 12, but the settings list includes '13: Fieldbus Analog'. Recorded as printed; see REVIEW_NOTES.md.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Skip Frequency Hysteresis Band
parameters.function: The Skip Frequency function is used to avoid the Optidrive operating at a certain output frequency, for example at a frequency which causes mechanical resonance in a particular machine. Parameter P-27 defines the centre point of the skip frequency band, and is used in conjunction with P-26.
parameters.notes: The Optidrive output frequency will ramp through the defined band at the rates set in P-03 and P-04 respectively, and will not hold any output frequency within the defined band. If the frequency reference applied to the drive is within the band, the Optidrive output frequency will remain at the upper or lower limit of the band.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Skip Frequency Centre Point
parameters.function: Parameter P-27 defines the centre point of the skip frequency band, and is used in conjunction with P-26.

parameters.notes: SOURCE ERRATUM SUSPECTED: P-28 and P-29 are BOTH printed with the name 'V/F Characteristic Adjustment Voltage', and the shared description sentence references 'the voltage set in P-29' although P-29's units are Hz and P-28's units are V. Recorded exactly as printed; see REVIEW_NOTES.md.

parameters.name: Start Mode, Automatic Restart, Fire Mode Operation
parameters.function: Configures start behaviour after power on / reset, the Automatic Restart function, and Fire Mode input logic and type.

settings: EdgE-r: Following Power on or reset, the drive will not start if Digital Input 1 remains closed. The Input must be closed after a power on or reset to start the drive.
AUto-0: Following a Power On or Reset, the drive will automatically start if Digital Input 1 is closed.

AUto-1 To AUto-5: Following a trip, the drive will make up to 5 attempts to restart at 20 second intervals. The numbers of restart attempts are counted, and if the drive fails to start on the final attempt, the drive will trip with a fault, and will require the user to manually reset the fault. The drive must be powered down to reset the counter.
indices.notes: Selects whether the drive should start automatically if the enable input is present and latched during power on. Also configures the Automatic Restart function. The Default column prints 'Edge-r'; the settings text prints the display form 'EdgE-r'.

settings: 0: n.C: Normally Closed (NC) Input. Fire Mode active if input is open.
1: n.O: Normally Open (NO) Input. Fire Mode active if input is closed.
2: F-N.C: Normally Closed (NC) Input, Fixed Speed. Fire Mode active if input is open. Fire Mode Speed is Preset Speed 4 (P-23).
3: F-N.O: Normally Open (NO) Input, Fixed Speed. Fire Mode active if input is closed. . Fire Mode Speed is Preset Speed 4 (P-23).
indices.notes: Defines the operating logic when a setting of P-15 is used which includes Fire Mode, e.g. settings 15, 16 & 17. (Double full stop in setting 3 is as printed.)

settings: 0: Off. The drive will remain in Fire Mode, only as long the fire mode input signal remains (Normally Open or Normally Closed operation is supported depending on Index 2 setting).

1: On. Fire Mode is activated by a momentary signal on the input. Normally Open or Normally Closed operation is supported depending on Index 2 setting. The drive will remain in Fire Mode until disabled or powered off.
indices.notes: Defines the input type when a setting of P-15 is used which includes Fire Mode, e.g. settings 15, 16 & 17.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Keypad Start Mode Select
parameters.function: This parameter is active only when operating in Keypad Control Mode (P-12 = 1 or 2) or Modbus Mode (P-12 = 3 or 4). When settings 0, 1, 4 or 5 are used, the Keypad Start and Stop keys are active, and control terminals 1 and 2 must be linked together. Settings 2, 3, 6 and 7 allow the drive to be started from the control terminals directly, and the keypad Start and Stop keys are ignored.
settings: 0: Minimum Speed, Keypad Start
1: Previous Speed, Keypad Start
2: Minimum Speed, Terminal Enable
3: Previous Speed, Terminal Enable
4: Current Speed, Keypad Start
5: Preset Speed 4, Keypad Start
6: Current Speed, Terminal Start
7: Preset Speed 4, Terminal Start

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: DC Injection Configuration
parameters.function: Configures DC injection braking duration and mode. DC Injection current level may be adjusted in P-59.

indices.notes: Defines the time for which a DC current is injected into the motor.

settings: 0: DC Injection on Stop. DC is injected into the motor at the current level set in P-59 following a stop command, after the output frequency has reduced to P-58 for the time set in Index 1. NOTE If the drive is in Standby Mode prior to disable, the DC injection is disabled

1: DC Injection on Start. DC is injected into the motor at the current level set in P-59 for the time set in Index 1 immediately after the drive is enabled, prior to the output frequency ramping up. The output stage remains active during this phase. This can be used to ensure the motor is at standstill prior to starting.
2: DC Injection on Start & Stop. DC injection applied as both settings 0 and 1 above.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Spin Start
parameters.function: Controls whether the drive attempts to determine if the motor is already rotating on start up.
settings: 0: Disabled

1: Enabled. When enabled, on start up the drive will attempt to determine if the motor is already rotating, and will begin to control the motor from its current speed. A short delay may be observed when starting motors which are not turning.
2: Enabled on Trip, Brown Out or Coast Stop. Spin start is only activated following the events listed, otherwise it is disabled.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Brake Chopper Enable (Not Size 1)
parameters.function: Enables the internal brake chopper for use with an external brake resistor.
settings: 0: Disabled
1: Enabled With Software Protection. Brake chopper enabled with software protection for a 200W continuous rated resistor.
2: Enabled Without Software Protection. Enables the internal brake chopper without software protection. An external thermal protection device should be fitted.
3: Enabled With Software Protection. As setting 1, however the Brake Chopper is only enabled during a change of the frequency setpoint, and is disabled during constant speed operation.
4: Enabled Without Software Protection. As setting 2, however the Brake Chopper is only enabled during a change of the frequency setpoint, and is disabled during constant speed operation.
parameters.notes: The name as printed includes '(Not Size 1)'.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Analog Input 1 Scaling / Slave Speed Scaling
parameters.function: Analog Input 1 Scaling. The analog input signal level is multiplied by this factor, e.g. if P-16 is set for a 0 - 10V signal, and the scaling factor is set to 200.0%, a 5 volt input will result in the drive running at maximum frequency / speed (P-01). Slave Speed Scaling. When operating in Slave Mode (P-12 = 9), the operating speed of the drive will be the Master speed multiplied by this factor, limited by the minimum and maximum speeds.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Serial Communications Configuration
parameters.function: This parameter has three sub settings used to configure the Modbus RTU Serial Communications.

indices.notes: 2nd Index: Baud Rate & Network type: Selects the baud rate and network type for the internal RS485 communication port. For Modbus RTU: Baud rates 9.6, 19.2, 38.4, 57.6, 115.2 kbps are available. For CAN: Baud rates 125, 250, 500 & 1000 kbps are available.

3rd Index: Watchdog Timeout: Defines the time for which the drive will operate without receiving a valid command telegram after the drive has been enabled. This applies to Modbus RTU networks and Optibus networks (e.g. keypad control or Master Slave operation) only. CAN communication loss function is enabled via CAN objects 100Ch and 100Dh. Setting 0 disables the Watchdog timer. Setting a value of 30, 100, 1000, or 3000 defines the time limit in milliseconds for operation. A 't' suffix selects trip on loss of communication. An 'r' suffix means that the drive will coast stop (output immediately disabled) but will not trip.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Access Code Definition
parameters.function: Defines the access code which must be entered in P-14 to access parameters above P-14.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Parameter Access Lock
parameters.function: Locks or unlocks parameter changes.
settings: 0: Unlocked. All parameters can be accessed and changed.
1: Locked. Parameter values can be displayed, but cannot be changed except P-38.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Analog Input 1 Offset
parameters.function: Sets an offset, as a percentage of the full scale range of the input, which is applied to the analog input signal. This parameter operates in conjunction with P-35, and the resultant value can be displayed in P00-01.
parameters.notes: The resultant value is defined as a percentage, according to the following: P00-01 = (Applied Signal Level(%) - P-39) x P-35).

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Display Scaling Factor / Display Scaling Source
parameters.function: Allows the user to program the Optidrive to display an alternative output unit scaled from either output frequency (Hz), Motor Speed (RPM) or the signal level of PI feedback when operating in PI Mode.

indices.notes: Used to set the scaling multiplier. The chosen source value is multiplied by this factor.

settings: 0: Motor Speed. Scaling is applied to the output frequency if P-10 = 0, or motor RPM if P-10 > 0.
1: Motor Current. Scaling is applied to the motor current value (Amps).
2: Analog Input 2 Signal Level. Scaling is applied to analog input 2 signal level, internally represented as 0 - 100.0%.
3: PI Feedback. Scaling is applied to the PI feedback selected by P-46, internally represented as 0 - 100.0%.

parameters.notes: The source prints this parameter as two Index rows; the combined name used here is derived from the two index names.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: PI Controller Proportional Gain
parameters.function: PI Controller Proportional Gain. Higher values provide a greater change in the drive output frequency in response to small changes in the feedback signal. Too high a value can cause instability.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: PI Controller Integral Time
parameters.function: PI Controller Integral Time. Larger values provide a more damped response for systems where the overall process responds slowly.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: PI Controller Operating Mode
parameters.function: Selects the PI controller operating mode.
settings: 0: Direct Operation. Use this mode if when the feedback signal drops, the motor speed should increase.
1: Inverse Operation. Use this mode if when the feedback signal drops, the motor speed should decrease.
2: Direct Operation, Wake at Full Speed. As setting 0, but on restart from Standby, PI Output is set to 100%.
3: Inverse Operation, Wake at Full Speed. As setting 0, but on restart from Standby, PI Output is set to 100%.
parameters.notes: Setting 3 text says 'As setting 0' as printed.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: PI Reference (Setpoint) Source Select
parameters.function: Selects the source for the PID Reference / Setpoint.
settings: 0: Digital Preset Setpoint. P-45 is used.
1: Analog Input 1 Setpoint. Analog input 1 signal level, readable in P00-01 is used for the setpoint.
2: Fieldbus. The setpoint is determined by fieldbus PDO2 (Modbus RTU register 3) value.
parameters.notes: SOURCE INCONSISTENCY: the printed Maximum is 1, but the settings list includes '2: Fieldbus'. Recorded as printed; see REVIEW_NOTES.md.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: PI Digital Setpoint
parameters.function: When P-44 = 0, this parameter sets the preset digital reference (setpoint) used for the PI Controller as a % of the feedback signal.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: PI Feedback Source Select
parameters.function: Selects the source of the feedback signal to be used by the PI controller.
settings: 0: Analog Input 2 (Terminal 4) Signal level readable in P00-02.
1: Analog Input 1 (Terminal 6) Signal level readable in P00-01.
2: Motor Current Scaled as % of P-08.
3: DC Bus Voltage Scaled 0 - 1000 Volts = 0 - 100%.
4: Analog 1 - Analog 2 The value of Analog Input 2 is subtracted from Analog 1 to give a differential signal. The value is limited to 0.
5: Largest (Analog 1, Analog 2) The larger of the two analog input values is always used for PI feedback.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Analog Input 2 Signal Format
parameters.function: Selects the signal format for Analog Input 2.
settings: U 0-10 = 0 to 10 Volt Signal.
A 0-20 = 0 to 20mA Signal.
t 4-20 = 4 to 20mA Signal, the Optidrive will trip and show the fault code 4-20F 500ms after the signal level falls below 3mA.
r 4-20 = 4 to 20mA Signal, the Optidrive will run at Preset Speed 1 (P-20) if the signal level falls below 3mA.
t 20-4 = 20 to 4mA Signal, the Optidrive will trip and show the fault code 4-20F 500ms after the signal level falls below 3mA.
r 20-4 = 20 to 4mA Signal, the Optidrive will run at Preset Speed 1 (P-20) if the signal level falls below 3mA.
Ptc-th = Use for motor thermistor measurement, valid with any setting of P-15 that has Input 3 as E-Trip. Trip level: 2.5kΩ, reset 2kΩ.
parameters.notes: TABLE LAYOUT AMBIGUITY: in the printed row, Minimum / Maximum / Default columns show '-' and the Units column shows 'U0-10'. 'U0-10' is recorded here as the default (matching the layout of the equivalent parameter P-16, where U0-10 is printed in the Default column). See REVIEW_NOTES.md.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Standby Mode Timer
parameters.function: When standby mode is enabled by setting P-48 > 0.0, the drive will enter standby following a period of operating at minimum speed (P-02) for the time set in P-48. When in Standby Mode, the drive display shows 'Stndby', and the output to the motor is disabled.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: PI Control Wake Up Error Level
parameters.function: When the drive is operating in PI Control Mode (P-12 = 5 or 6), and Standby Mode is enabled (P-48 > 0.0), P-49 can be used to define the PI Error Level (E.g. difference between the setpoint and feedback) required before the drive restarts after entering Standby Mode. This allows the drive to ignore small feedback errors and remain in Standby mode until the feedback drops sufficiently.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: User Output Relay Hysteresis
parameters.function: Sets the hysteresis level for P-19 to prevent the output relay chattering when close to the threshold.

parameters.name: Motor Parameter Autotune
parameters.function: When enabled, the drive immediately measures required data from the motor for optimal operation. Ensure all motor related parameters are correctly set first before enabling this parameter.
settings: 0: Disabled
1: Enabled.
parameters.notes: This parameter can be used to optimise the performance when P-51 = 0. Autotune is not required if P-51 = 1. For settings 2 - 5 of P-51, autotune MUST be carried out AFTER all other required motor settings are entered.

source.document: Optidrive E3 IP20 User Guide V1.05 (82-E3I20-IN)

parameters.name: Motor Overload Management
parameters.function: Configures motor thermal overload retention and the reaction when the overload limit is reached.

settings: 0: Disabled
1: Enabled. When enabled, the drive calculated motor overload protection information is retained after the mains power is removed from the drive.
indices.notes: The Units column for this Index row prints '1' (suspected misprint for '-'); recorded as printed. See REVIEW_NOTES.md.

settings: 0: It.trp. When the overload accumulator reaches the limit, the drive will trip on It.trp to prevent damage to the motor.

1: Current Limit Reduction. When the overload accumulator reaches 90% of, the output current limit is internally reduced to 100% of P-08 in order to avoid an It.trp. The current limit will return to the setting in P-54 when the overload accumulator reaches 10%.
indices.notes: The Units column for this Index row prints '1' (suspected misprint for '-'); recorded as printed. The phrase 'reaches 90% of,' is as printed in the source (apparently truncated). See REVIEW_NOTES.md.

parameters.name: Modbus Mode Selection
parameters.function: Selects how Modbus RTU telegrams are validated.
settings: 0: Standard. All Modbus RTU telegrams are valid regardless of the destination address. Communication loss timeout will activate when no valid Modbus RTU message is present within the time limit set in P-36.

1: Advanced. Only Modbus RTU telegrams intended for the specific node address are valid. Communication loss timeout will activate when no Modbus RTU message intended for the specific drive node address is received within the time limit set in P-36. This mode is intended for use in small networks and must be used with other fieldbus gateways i.e. Modbus TCP or Ethernet/IP.
